calculate_employee_pay sets v_taxable_income = v_period_gross (pretax deductions not subtracted)

EMPLOYEE_BANK_ACCOUNTS table not referenced anywhere in this package — no add/update/deactivate/read procedures exist; no ACH disbursement step after approve_payroll; no NACHA file generation; direct deposit is unimplemented (AV-024, RISK-013)
ACCOUNT_NUMBER_ENC decryption path missing — no decrypt_account_number function exists in any package; encryption key and algorithm unknown (AV-025, RISK-014)

components.name: DB Triggers (6 triggers)
public_methods: TRG_EMP_BEFORE_INSERT: auto-stamp defaults, hire date +180 day check, email uniqueness
TRG_EMP_BEFORE_UPDATE: auto-stamp modified, block direct TERMINATED→ACTIVE, write EMPLOYEE_HISTORY on status/dept/job change
TRG_EMP_INSTEAD_OF_DELETE: block all physical deletes of EMPLOYEES
TRG_SALARY_AUDIT: AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on SALARY_RECORDS → PKG_AUDIT.log_action
TRG_LEAVE_REQUEST_AUDIT: AFTER UPDATE OF STATUS on LEAVE_REQUESTS → PKG_AUDIT.log_action
TRG_DEPARTMENT_AUDIT: AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on DEPARTMENTS → PKG_AUDIT.log_action
called_by: Any DML on EMPLOYEES, SALARY_RECORDS, LEAVE_REQUESTS, DEPARTMENTS tables
risk_flags: TRG_EMP_BEFORE_INSERT allows hire date +180 days; HRMS_EMPLOYEE form only allows +90 days — inconsistency
TRG_EMP_BEFORE_UPDATE writes to EMPLOYEE_HISTORY using HISTORY_ID (column not in schema definition — HIST_ID is) — possible column name mismatch
Trigger logic duplicates PKG_EMPLOYEE logic (noted as anti-pattern in trg_employees.sql comment)
TRG_EMP_INSTEAD_OF_DELETE named 'INSTEAD_OF' but declared as BEFORE DELETE (misleading name)
